a.en: The listed address is Jl. Taman Kopo Indah 1 No.11 Blk F, Margahayu Selatan, Kabupaten Bandung, Jawa Barat 40226. Use the map for directions.

a.id: Peta mencantumkan Senin–Sabtu 10.00–20.00; Minggu 10.00–15.00. Konfirmasikan jadwal sebelum berangkat.
a.en: The map lists Monday–Saturday 10am–8pm and Sunday 10am–3pm. Confirm before visiting.
